intro: After Driftwood, Watcher Biggs has one last job for you while the wagon is being repaired. Biggs has packed up the key supplies rescued from the ogre attacks and wants you to carry them to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While I fix this wagon, friend, I have one last task for you.
I have packed the most vital supplies saved from the ogre attacks. Take them to Nethergarde Keep. The keep is nestled in the northern hills of the Blasted Lands, keeping watch over the Dark Portal.
To reach Nethergard, follow the road east. When it branches head south into the Blasted Lands, then turn left at the next fork. Follow the road, friend, and be wary.

clips.title: Completion
paras: What? A package from Biggs' caravan? We thought it, and he, were lost.
Thank you, friend. With luck, these supplies will carry the much needed reagent, Azoran Crystals. Our stock is running low...
